name: The Library
body: Smaller than Ghost Haven's tower and no less loved. Floor-to-ceiling shelves on two walls — bolted, because the brats-per-square-foot ratio here makes the structural risk real. Petra practically lives in it; her leather-bound journal mapping everyone's emotional patterns sits on the desk like a devotional text. Minerva's star-map notebooks fill a shelf. Umiko's swim schedules are pinned to a corkboard because Petra insisted they stay visible, which Umiko pretends she does not find devastatingly sweet.
